title: Mystic Structures
description: Adds new structures to the world with good resources, some structures are even creepy.
body:
This mod expands world generation capabilities by adding a variety of handcrafted structures that open up new exploration opportunities and imbue the world with a richer, more mysterious atmosphere. Each structure fits harmoniously into the Minecraft world, offering unique chests filled with rewards.
Perfect for players who enjoy exploration, adventure, and discovering secrets hidden beneath the surface.
